title: Weekly content plan
ask: Plan the content for the coming week: three short posts and one newsletter, each one planned for a particular day of that week. Draw only on the company's own documents and on what the company did last week, and do not invent facts. Write each piece as a draft for me to read. Nothing is to be published or sent. In your report, say which facts you were missing and could not find, so that I can supply them.
